name: Trevali Mining Corporation
summary: Trevali Mining Corporation operates as a base-metals miner, engaging in the full spectrum of activities from identifying and acquiring mineral properties to their exploration, development, and eventual production. The company's primary exploration focus is on discovering and extracting deposits rich in zinc, lead, silver, copper, and gold. Its portfolio of operational assets features the 90%-owned Perkoa Mine in Burkina Faso, the 90%-owned Rosh Pinah Mine in Namibia, and the Caribou Mine situated in northern New Brunswick, Canada. Additionally, Trevali holds interests in other prospective properties, including Halfmile, Stratmat, and Restigouche in New Brunswick, Canada; the Gergarub project in Namibia; and the Ruttan Mine in northern Manitoba, Canada. The corporation also maintains an option to acquire complete 100% ownership of the Heath Steele deposit, located in New Brunswick, Canada. Originally incorporated in 1964 as Trevali Resources Corp., the company rebranded as Trevali Mining Corporation in April 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
